newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Akzo up, DSM down after results.
newsitem.headline: Akzo up, DSM down after results.

text.p: Shares in chemicals group Akzo Nobel NV continued their strong rise on Friday following Thursday's well-received second-quarter results.
The shares ended Thursday's session 18.30 guilders higher, and added another 14.30 guilders on Friday to stand at 335.10 guilders around midday.
"The analyst meeting was at 1600 (local time), so people will have read all the reports overnight," one dealer said.
"There's a lot of U.S. demand for the stock," another said.
The 25 percent jump in Akzo's quarterly earnings was well above analysts' expectations.
By contrast, shares in Akzo's sector peer DSM NV have drifted lower since the firm reported first-half net profits up 13 percent on Wednesday, at the low end of expectations.
The shares lost 18.50 guilders on Wednesday, recovered slightly on Thursday, adding 7.00 guilders, but shed another 1.10 guilders to stand at 217.40 guilders by noon on Friday.
"Obviously, DSM's figures were not half as good as Akzo's," one dealer said.
